title: DAG circuit family as a tree family
statement: Every family of directed acyclic Boolean circuits determines a family of Boolean circuit trees by unfolding each circuit in the family, for every input length, into a tree circuit.
hypotheses_covered: a family of directed acyclic Boolean circuits, with one circuit for each natural input length
